bayts.text: My ink and my pens are for the One Who drove back the sea, as He drove back Satan, ignorance and grief.
Allah has effaced (the lot) that I should meet the harm that has struck His creatures at large; my refuge is in the Everlasting (Al-Bāqī), Who has made my service firm.
From the Fire and from Satan I have taken refuge, joined through my Lord to the servants of him with Whom is the loftiest rank.
I have intended, by my praise of him whose gift has reached me — and truly I, by what was chosen for me, am certainly of his household —
devotion to an Enricher whose like is utterly not to be found, and whose beauty has come to meet me in this world and the Next.
I have cast away falsehoods for Allah — exalted is His Majesty — in my praise of him whose praises have driven sorrow away.
Allah tames time for me by the standing of the Chosen; upon him the two peaces of the Everlasting, wherever he appears.
My certainty protects me from doubt in secret and in public; and my Lord has led to me, through the Prophet, joy and safety.
Upon my right hand lies the debt of a writing that shows the traditions of the Intercessor, who spared me, without harm, from the oppressors.
I rejoice that I am made shrewd by his awakening, and that I am quenched by the clearest of his waters.
My God has folded up for me the distance of my journey by his standing, and the best of strivings became clear to me after its obscurity.
I have folded up the path of the (Sufi) folk in the time of his praise, and He has fulfilled my needs with discipline and expansion.
Upon me lies a fair service to the Radiant, beautified one, for the Countenance of my God, Lord of creation, the Beautifier.
I have forgiven for the Countenance of Allah, with purity of breast, and I have spoken (these verses) to please the Last in the line (of Prophets), the hoped-for:
upon the Chosen the two most lasting peaces of the Perfecter, with the Family and the Companions, whose benefit is my benefit.
O my God, toward the Chosen (al-Mukhtār) turn what he has chosen, and bless him with peace and ennoble him.
To the Chosen convey joy and give him precedence; and from me accept my service and magnify it.
I say: O my God, bless on my behalf and grant peace upon the Chosen, with (his) party, whose love is my hidden treasure.
Lead to him a gift surpassing his gift, and increase him in a radiant beauty within his beauty.
For him write, through him, that my being be gladness to his Family and his Companions, joy to him together with his men.
For him write a blessing with peace, with his Family and his Companions, O One, exalted above any like.
My gain is praise of him whose praise is booty; and I, until the Gardens, am lavished with favours by glad tidings.
I have raised my affair to Allah — and all of me is believing with him, submitting — serving him who is a ladder.
A noble Messenger, unrivalled in glory, honoured, bearer of glad tidings and warner from Him, with benefit and harm.
He Who illumined the intellect has given me to drink from the cup of the (Sufi) folk, by my being servant of him who long ago relieved distress.
I have been kept safe from all enemies, taking refuge with my Lord; and the gate of Allah has not been shut.
Peace upon al-Māḥī, who drove back the darkness, Muḥammad, sent with sincere counsel and might.
My Lord has guarded me from enemies through him — and he is a lion — and through him the criminal has turned forever toward others than me.
And through him the lover and the submitter come toward me; Muḥammad, the Chosen, abases (the rebel) and honours (the pious).
Eminent with the Master — He is the Most High —, foremost: his are gentleness with firmness and cheer with vigour.
To my Lord, Who has led to me what I willed, without restriction, goes my gratitude for al-Māḥī, through whom I have triumphed by ascent.
Toward others than me every wretched one has turned, by the Chosen; and through him the blessed and the God-fearing come toward me.
His are primacy, precedence, nearness and the meeting (with Allah); and he forever abases whoever comes against me without goodness.
I am free of enemies, and Allah has illumined my heart and expiated from me evil and harm.
My God has ransomed me with him who showed hatred, and through the Chosen He has purified all of me from defect.
My success, by the grace of Allah, has run in His Tablet, without effacement, without guile or fear.
Upon my pens lies the debt of serving him who is my blessing, and serving him has cleansed my error and my stain.
I have overcome, through my Lord, those whom He repelled with retribution; and I have said — and the best of creation is my all and my mercy —:
my needs have already turned to Allah through my service to the best of creation, who led to me the most excellent emancipation.
I called upon my God — and He enriches whoever asks — and He drove toward others than me, through the Prophet, every aggressor.
My supplication Allah has answered, as joy for the rightly guided; and I make manifest for the Countenance of Allah the truth for whoever follows the example.
What called me to praise the Last in the line (of Prophets), Muḥammad, is obedience to a Lord Who through me brings the rightly directed to the goal.
The Everlasting has granted me the loftiest of merits, and whoever calls to vice turns forever toward others than me.
I say — and toward the Chosen tends my fair work — (becoming) a lamp for my people with sublime sciences.
I obey my God, serving the Means of approach (al-Wasīla), Muḥammad, who wards off calamities by repelling them.
I began to call upon the Chosen with good manners, and he drove back the enemies, folk to be shunned.
You asked for me, O Messenger of Allah, beyond my request, from Allah, my Lord; and the hope was not disappointed.
The tyrants of creation you have driven, by Allah, O Prophet, toward others than me, without my meeting them, acknowledging my due.
To the One, the Subduer (Al-Qahhār), Who bestowed right guidance, I humbly prayed before the year (of trial), a servant among the enemies.
The Master, through you, has answered my prayer, making my tongue upright as He purified my heart, (making it) affirm the Oneness.
The Master has softened for me, through you, forever, the enviers, and they went back toward others than me, repentant of (their) hatred.
Upon the Chosen, who repels the enemies in his fighting, the two peaces of a Generous One Who counted me among his men.
I have forgiven, and truly I am well-pleasing among his household, happy, obeyed, triumphant through union with him.
Upon him a blessing with peace, with his Family and his Companions, lions against the enemies, constant in repelling them.
You have removed trial, ignorance, poverty and toil, and led to me, O Chosen, what is good of wealth.
To Allah (goes) my praise together with you, O you to whom eulogy belongs; I say it, and my aim is gratitude in the abodes, for long ages.
O my God, by the standing of the Chosen You have led the wishes to me: so grant me a lasting gratitude, with healing.
To You be thanks and praise, O best of sovereigns, for him who has Companions who rose above every wayfarer.
To You forever, O Singular, exalted above any partner, my gratitude for him who bestowed on me the rites.
Veil my faults for me and guide every devotee through me; and on my behalf bless the best of creation perpetually.
To You forever, O Everlasting, without (other) craving, all of me; and I am not, toward the Master, a dull servant and a burden (cf. Qurʾān 16:76).
Spread for me, until the Gardens, good with union, and grant me lasting joy and command, O Possessor of grace.
To You forever my soul: purify it, and guide my people through me; and bless with peace the most excellent of the Messengers.
The gifts of my praise of the Chosen, here they are, for (Your) Countenance, O my God; and grant me the best knowledge and increase my alertness.
Your gifts to me have exhausted my gratitude in (their) essence; Yours is the praise, O Singular: You are exalted above all likeness.
You have guided, through my creed, Sufism and jurisprudence (fiqh), my household, by my remembrance, my prayer and the praise.
